scripts.deploy: yarn workspace gig-api build:lambda && yarn run tf:init && cd infra && terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=terraform.prod.tfvars && cd .. && bash scripts/update-frontend-env.sh && bash scripts/publish-frontend.sh
scripts.deploy:dev: yarn workspace gig-api build:lambda && yarn run tf:init:dev && cd infra && terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=terraform.dev.tfvars && cd .. && bash scripts/update-frontend-env.sh && bash scripts/publish-frontend.sh
scripts.deploy:ci: yarn workspace gig-api build:lambda && yarn run tf:init:ci && cd infra && terraform apply -auto-approve -input=false -lock-timeout=30m && cd .. && bash scripts/update-frontend-env.sh && bash scripts/publish-frontend.sh
scripts.destroy:soft: yarn run tf:init && cd infra && terraform destroy -auto-approve -input=false -var-file=terraform.prod.tfvars
scripts.destroy: bash scripts/empty-stack-s3-buckets.sh prod && yarn run destroy:soft
scripts.destroy:dev:soft: yarn run tf:init:dev && cd infra && terraform destroy -auto-approve -input=false -var-file=terraform.dev.tfvars
scripts.destroy:dev: bash scripts/empty-stack-s3-buckets.sh dev && yarn run destroy:dev:soft
